newsitem.title: NORWAY: Adspend up 15 pct in Norway last year - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Adspend up 15 pct in Norway last year - newspaper.

text.p: Norwegian companies spent 8.9 billion crowns on advertising in 1996, up 15 percent from the year before, daily newspaper Aftenposten said on Thursday.
It said most advertising was made in newspapers, who held 46.3 percent of the market. They were followed by television, radio, magazine, billboard and cinema ads.
Advertising for entertainment shot up 80 percent to 341 million crowns, bank and finance ads grew 41 percent to 378 million crowns while car ads increased 39 percent to 870 million crowns, it said.
